id: title:DanielVisca:wait for the feature preview before loading metric names

observations.behavior: Adds a mount-time effect to immediately request available metric names before other setup checks.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce perceived latency for users entering the Metrics scene by pre-loading metadata. It also changes ordering of API calls; if dependent downstream requests rely on cached results rather than fresh ones, this could cause duplicate or unnecessary network requests.

observations.behavior: Restricts the initial list loading and subsequent priming actions behind a feature flag check.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes behavior based on configuration: without the flag, no metrics are requested at all. This is an access-control-like gating mechanism that prevents unauthenticated or unauthorized data retrieval, potentially reducing unnecessary backend load but not changing tier value.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that the new gated flow only performs one retrieval after the flag is enabled and explicitly triggered.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against unintended repeated fetches when the gate opens. Tests do not establish benefit, they establish expected behavior under the implemented change.

observations.limitations: The implementation does not demonstrate broader systemic improvements such as query optimization, recovery handling, or shared infrastructure hardening. The observed change is localized to request sequencing and conditional execution within the frontend metrics module. No evidence supports claims of performance gains, incident avoidance, or wider architectural benefits; these remain conjecture. Tier 3 requires demonstrated material breadth across components or critical paths, which this chunk lacks. Tier 2 could apply if we treat bounded correctness improvement as sufficient, but the absence of clear failure prevention or reliability checks keeps it conservative. No adoption, WPR, or release notes were used.

review.reason: This chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded capability improvement: reordering API calls and adding feature-flag-gated loading for metric metadata in the Metrics scene. This could reduce perceived latency and prevent unneeded requests, with accompanying tests checking the gating behavior. It does not reach tier 3 because there is no broader systemic impact, cross-component dependency changes, or demonstrated risk reduction beyond this single path. No tier 1 maintenance-only classification applies since the change alters observable user-facing behavior and adds configuration-dependent control.
review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog's product team and users accessing the Metrics section. Could improve responsiveness and avoid unnecessary backend load when the feature is disabled. Not an indicator of actual benefit without further context on baseline behavior or downstream dependencies.
review.uncertainty: The exact performance and compatibility implications depend on how dependent components consume cached results; these are not shown. The implementation also relies on shared constants and existing kea patterns, which could introduce subtle ordering bugs if other parts assume different initialization sequences.
